name:
KS-11Z
Keyboard Stand
description:
The feature-rich KS-11Z provides a rugged, attractive, and stable platform for 88-note stage pianos and other portable keyboards. Steel construction offers robust performance, while multiple adjustment points allow you to tailor the stand’s width and height for any home, stage, or studio setup. Assembly is fast and easy with integrated push pins and foldable padded support arms.

For over five decades, Roland has been a worldwide leader in stage pianos, synthesizers, and other keyboards for musicians from hobbyist to professional. The KS-11Z is filled with smart design details informed by our long development knowledge, delivering a premium experience for all types of instruments. Heavy-duty steel construction and a solid Z shape provide rock-solid stability in a minimal footprint, making it a great solution for supporting 88-note pianos in the RD and FP series and other heavy keyboards.

The KS-11Z is designed for precision adjustment, with a quick-release lever that enables you to set the width to any position within a wide range.

You can sometimes come across uneven surfaces on performance stages and in studio environments. The KS-11Z features adjustable feet to eliminate wobble and dial in the perfect balance for your situation.

The KS-11Z features a foldable design for transport and storage. When you’re ready to use the stand, simply unfold the padded arms and they will automatically lock in place. And when the gig’s over, press the buttons to release the pins and fold the arms back down.

Superior Roland Performance

Seamless Width Adjustment

Maximum Stability

Fast and Smooth Assembly
